column1: # Kegare, a demon from another age who has taken Mia's visage.

column3: At last. I've watched you\nprotect her, and now I can\nsee what she sees in you.{end_wait}
You look exactly like Mia.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I am Kegare, a demon
from an age long past.
I studied her voice and
learned her mannerisms.{page_break}Now I will take her place.
Her life, her name, and
her place among you will
be mine.{end_wait}
Mia is not a place for you\nto take. You'll have to get\nthrough us first.{end_wait}

You may wear my face, but
you do not know my life.
You cannot claim my place
by copying what you see.{end_wait}

Then let them decide which
of us they believe. When
I am finished, they will
remember only me.{end_wait}
They know me by my choices,\nnot the shape of my face.\nYou will never become me.{end_wait}
